(ja)༄༅/ /paṇa chen zla ba gzhon nu'i lugs kyi dbyangs can ma dkar mo phyag bzhi ma'i sgrub thabs man ngag dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/sha

tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// paṇa chen zla ba gzhon nu'i lugs kyi dbyangs can ma dkar mo phyag bzhi ma'i sgrub thabs man ngag dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ shrī badz+ra swa ra swa tī de wī no pi kaṃ/ bod skad du/ dpal rdo rje lha mo dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo// gangs ri ltar dkar zla rgyas zhal mnga' dri med bsil zhing gsal ba'i 'od zer phreng ba can// sgeg chags 'gying tshul 'dzum pa'i mdangs dkar lha yi lha mo kun nas mdzes pa'i gzi ldan ma// stong phrag drug cu'i yan lag dbyangs can rgyud mangs rol mo ut+pal ral gris phyag mtshan cing*// 'jig rten gsum skyabs mkha' dang rgya mtsho'i rgyun gyur blo gros lha mo khyod nyid rgyal gyur cig 1 /pha rol rgol ba tshar gcad dang*// mtha' yas spobs pa kun bskyed dang*// sna tshogs phrin las bde bsgrub phyir// dbyangs can lha mo bsgrub par bya/ 2 /'phags pa de dag mgon bzung nas// 'gro skyabs don kun myur brtson pas// sman ljongs rab dkar brag rir ni// rnam g.yengs spangs te tshogs rab bsag 3 /dus snyigs bar chad kun bsal phyir// sngon du sngags pas rdo rje 'dzin// mnyes byas de rjes snying rje'i yid// rab sbyangs rdo rje lha mo bsgom/ 4 /sngags bdag nga rgyal la bstan srog /rtsa ba'i yi ge sgron 'dra yi// zer spros pas ni rgya mtsho nas// dbyangs can 'khor lo mdun du dgug 5 /oṃ e h+ye hi

tshur spyon/ rdo rje lha mo 'khor lo chen po dam tshig brgyad pa 'du bang mdzod/ badz+ra de wī ma hā tsakra sa ma yāṣ+ṭaṃ sa mā dzaḥ gzhal med khang du srog gi ni// 'khor lo sku dang thugs 'khor lo// sna gsum 'od 'bar dri med mdzes// mkha' la zla rgyas ltar drangs te/ 6 /rab dwangs kun dga' khrus sogs dbul// me tog bdug pa mar me dri// zhal zas rol mo rgyan phreng dag /pi wang lhan cig sngags bcas mchod/ 7 /'bru gsum glu gar lhan byas bstod// phyag mchod las sogs rgyud kun gyis// mnyes bya gsol bya bstim par bya// gnas la gnas dang lus la sku/ 8 /snying dkyil 'khor lo phyag rgyas gdab// shel dang baiḍūr rā ga dang*// gser bzang las grub gzhal yas khang*// gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs mdzes/ 9 /sna tshogs rgyan rnams kun gyis spras// de dbus rdo rje lha mo ni// pad zlar rdo rje skyil krung gnon// brgyad gnyis na tshod yid 'ong ma// 'jig rten gsum na mtshungs med pa'o/ 10 /de sku ldem sgeg zhal gsum phyag /bzhi ldan ral gri ut+pal dang*// rgyud mangs pi wang sbreng mdzad brtson// nyi shar gangs ri ltar dkar blta/ 11 /thugs kar rab dkar shes rab kyi// snying po dkar mdzes hrīṃ yig gis// 'od chags rab 'jam dkar bkye bas// bum nang sgron ma 'bar ba bzhin/ 12 /sprin med mkha' dkyil zla ltar dkar// rnam dag 'khor lo 'od mdzad gzi// rim pas dbus nas mthar snang bya// nyi zer gyis phye pad 'dab tshul/ 13 /rtsa ba'i 'bru 'di snying 'dab kyi// dbus bzhugs bzhi gnyis kha phye nas// gnyis gnyis nga ro bcu drug rgyas// de spros ge sar ze'u 'bru phyed/ 14 /'dab bcas yi ge 'od 'bar bas// slar yang bdud rtsi'i zil mngar blang*// dkar 'jam snum mnyen mkhregs dang srab// yid 'ong dri mas ma gos pa/ 15 /zil mngar snying gi mun sel la// snying 'dab snying pos slar yang de'i// zil mngar rgyas byed yang tshur 'ong*// rab spros phyi nang kun dag byed/

16 /ji srid ma yengs mi skyo bas// bdag gzhan mkha' khyab kun bkang la// sdig sdug yid kyi mun pa rnams// nyi mas mun bsal ji bzhin no/ 17 /rtsa ba'i yi ge mchog gcig la// yengs med 'bum phrag bco lnga bzla// dngos dang rmi lam brda gzugs kyi// ltas gsum phyi rol mthong bar 'gyur/ 18 /de 'og pad+ma 'khor lo bsgyur// dbyangs yig ral gri phyed mtshan par// skad cig rnam par bsgyur zhing bskor// gsang sngags 'bru bcu bzla bar bya/ 19 /oṃ badz+ra kye rdo rje lha mo de wī pi 'jam pa 'jam pa tsu pi tsu pradzñā bar+dha shes rab 'phel ba/ hrīṃ hūm̐/ rang snying mun sel brtan pa dang*// gzhan yid mun sel g.yo ba yis// 'bum phrag gsum ni rtse gcig bzlas// lkugs pa'ang ngag gi dbang phyug 'gyur/ 20 /nang skya zla rgyas pa wa sangs// gsum pa sgron ma 'bar ba mthong*// brda gsum gzugs sgra yid shes te// mtshon cha'i 'khor lo rtags gzhan yin/ 21 /de nas sbyin sreg sngon song bas// brgya rtsa brgyad mchod blo gros spel// de yis tshar bcad rjes bzung las// lnga phrag gnyis 'gyur the tshom med/ 22 /rtsod dang dgra 'dul dug gzhil dang*// 'chi bdag bzlog pa dang po ste// blo gros sngags rig snyan ngag dang*// klog dang sngags 'grub gnyis pa yin/ 23 /de yang thog ma gnyis gtso mos// lhag ma bzhi bzhi lha mo gzhan// 'khor yin lnga gnyis dkyil 'khor mdzes// de bzhin gnyis gtso gzhan brgyad 'khor/ 24 /rdo rje lha mo la gnas lce// 'khor la dbyangs ldan ral gris bskor// pha rol srog dang lce bkum nas// gsal byed mgrin bkang rtsod las rgyal/ 25 /mtshan ngan thod par dgra bo'i gzugs/ bsad par gyis /mā ra ya ldan lan 'bum bzlas// gri mtshon gyis gtubs ro ras dkris// 'dre gnas sar mnan nges par 'chi/ 26 /lhag pa'i lhas brgyan lha mo nyid// khro mo zhal brgya phyag stong bcas// lcags kyu zhags pa ral gri yis// bkug cing bsnun na shin tu 'joms/

27 /dam tshig lha mo ye shes kyi// lha grangs bum par bdud rtsi bsgrub// smin mtshams pad+ma hrīṃ thig le// rgyun 'dzag dug mthong reg kha rlangs bsam pa/ bzhi dbyung bar bya/ 28 /snying dkyil srog yig rin chen sgron// rdo rje 'bar ba'i me 'od gsal// ā phreng kā phreng spel skor gzis// gur phub rgyan 'bebs 'chi med 'gyur/ 29 /ji skad sngar bshad lha mo nyid// de bzhin lha mo lnga lnga dgu// sna gsum bdag gzhan snying la bsgom// blo gros rab 'phel gdon mi za/ 30 /dpal mo'i mgrin par chu skyes dbus// dung dkar g.yas 'khyil sbubs bstar ba// nga ro bcu drug gsang mthor sgrogs// de myur tshangs dbyangs ngag thob 'gyur/ 31 /gtsang zhing rab gtsang pad snying dbus// 'ja' ris dpal be'u zer gsal ba// glog phreng rgyun 'dra rdo rje'i lce// rnam dpyod snyan mngags mkha' ltar 'gyur/ 32 /'dam skyes ri bong rdo rje yi// sbyor bas lce rtser tshangs yig bskyed// lha mo'i bdag skyes rdo rje lhung*// de blangs ka la piṅkar mtshungs/ 33 /rje btsun ljags pad zla steng du// dbyangs gsal rdo rje ral gris mtshan// bro gar 'gyur bklags ye shes bkug /de rgyun sus 'thungs sngags 'grub gyur/ 34 /thun mtshams gtsang zhing rab dkar zas// mngar bsil sna tshogs btung bar bcas// 'bru gsum rang sngags byin brlabs la// bdud rtsi sbyar bas gtor ma sbyin/ 35 /oṃ āḥbadz+ra prī ti rdo rje dga' ba'i lha mo 'khor bcas bdud rtsi'i gtor ma zo zhig zo zhig de wī sa pa ri wā ra a mṛ ta ba liṃ khā hi khā hi/ ma bdag la dngos grub thams cad stsol zhes shugs la'o/ ma sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ 'jam dbyangs lha mo dbyangs snyan ma// rab mdzes tshangs dbyangs blo bzang ma// mtshungs med snying dbus mgrin skyong ma// 'dod rgur bsgyur la phyag 'tshal lo/ 36

/bde ldan ngag gi dbang phyug ma// mi 'tshe mi bslu tshe 'dzin ma// bag yod yid 'ong bde ster ma// tshangs spyod tshangs rigs ma khyod 'dud/ 37 /dpal ldan dbyangs can lha mo'i brtag pa'i de nyid rgya mtsho mkha' dang gter ltar zab cing rgya che sbas pa las// rdo rje lha mo ri dbang phung po sangs rgyas khang bzang lnga phrag gnyis sgrub nyes tshogs dri ma kun bsal 'di// zla zer shar bas ku mud ltar phye de yi lo mas dge 'ong rin chen 'bar ba'i sgron mthus gang thog des// ma lus lus can rdo rje lha mo'i dbyangs snyan myur thob tshangs chen nga ros sa gsum rnam par rol par shog /dpal rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs snyan mngags mkhan chen po slob dpon zla ba gzhon nus mdzad pa rdzogs so// rnam par bshad pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas pa chen po bud+dha shrī dzñā na dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong byams pa'i dpal gyis bsgyur ba'o// ༈ /rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs bsdus don bzhugs/ dpal rdo rje dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo// de'i sgrub thabs 'di la gsum ste/ klad kyi don dang*/ gzhung gi don dang*/ mjug gi don to// dang po la gnyis te/ shis par brjod pa'i sgo nas bstod pa dang*/ dgos 'brel bstan pa'i sgo nas bsgrub byar brjod pa'o// gzhung don la gnyis te/ thun gyi rim pa bstan pa dang*/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba bstan pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ bsnyen pa dang*/ las sbyor ro// dang po la gnyis te/ sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes kyi ltas bstan pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ tshogs bsag pa dang*/ bar chad bsal ba dang*/ kun slong sbyang ba'o// dngos gzhi la gnyis te/ shes rab kyi 'khor lo dgug pa dang*/ mnyam par gzhag pa'i tshul dang*/ ngang las bzlas pa bya ba'o// dang po la gnyis te/ 'khor lo spyan drang ba'i thabs dang*/ byon pa gsal gdab pa dang*/ mchod pa'i rim pa dang*/ phyag rgyas gdab pa'o// gsum pa la gnyis te/

mchod pa dngos dang*/ gsol ba gdab pa'o// dang po la lnga ste/ cha gsum gyis phu dud bya ba'i mchod pa dang*/ rdzas brgyad kyis bsnyen bkur gyi mchod pa dang*/ pi wang gis khyad par du bya ba'i mchod pa dang*/ glu gar gyis rnam par rol pa'i mchod pa dang*/ yan lag brgyad pas rjes su sgrub pa'i mchod pa'o// phyag rgyas gdab pa la gnyis te/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// gnyis pa mnyam par gzhag pa'i tshul la gnyis te/ rten gzhal yas khang bsgoms pa dang*/ brten pa lha bsgom pa dang*/ khyad par gyi ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa'i tshul lo// bar ma la gnyis te spyir bsgom pa dang*/ bye brag tu mdog mtshan phye ste bsgom pa'o// gsum pa khyad par gyi ting nge 'dzin la gsum ste/ yul gyi rten la dmigs pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ rten thabs dang sbyar ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ thabs las dang sbyar ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// dang po la gnyis te/ sa bon la dmigs pa dang*/ pad+ma la dmigs pa'o// gnyis pa rten thabs dang sbyar ba'i ting nge 'dzin la gsum ste/ sgom pa'i don dang*/ bzlas pa'i thabs dang*/ grub pa'i ltas so// bar pa la gnyis te/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ bye brag tu bstan pa'o// de la bzhi ste/ gang bzla bar bya ba'i sngags dang*/ ji ltar zlos pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ ji tsam du zlos pa'i grangs dang*/ de ltar bzlas pa'i phan yon no// gsum pa grub pa'i ltas la gnyis te/ mngon par 'dod pa'i ltas dang*/ mi 'dod pa'i ltas so// dang po la gnyis te/ sgron ma gsum dang*/ brda gsum mo// gsum pa las sbyor la gnyis te/ sngon du bya ba'i cho ga dang*/ las la sbyar ba'i phrin las so// de la gnyis te/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ bye brag tu bshad pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ lha rkyang gi dbang du byas pa dang*/ zhar la dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i dbang du byas pa'o// de la gsum ste/ lha lnga'i dbang du byas pa cha gnyis dang*/

lha dgu'i dbang du byas pa gcig go /gnyis pa bye brag tu bshad pa la gnyis te/ tshar gcod kyi las dang*/ rjes su gzung ba'i las so// dang po la lnga ste/ rtsod pa las rgyal ba dang*/ dgra gsad pa dang*/ bgegs gzhom pa dang*/ dug gzhil ba dang*/ 'chi ba bzlog pa'o// gnyis pa rjes su gzung ba la lnga ste/ blo gros spel ba dang*/ ngag gi rig pa bskyed pa dang*/ snyan mngags bsgrub pa dang*/ dbyangs snyan pa dang*/ sngags 'grub pa'i thabs so// gnyis pa thun mtshams kyi bya ba la gnyis te/ gtor ma dang*/ bstod pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ rdzas bsham pa dang*/ byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ 'bul ba'i sngags bstan pa'o// bstod pa la gnyis te/ sa gsum gyi dbang phyug mar bstod pa dang*/ bslab gzhi 'dzin pa'i dpal mgon mar bstod pa'o// dpal rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs kyi bsdus don ni/ ma hā lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis bdag gzhan gyi blo gros 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir dpal khro phu dga' ldan gyi gtsug lag khang du nye bar sbyar ba rdzogs so// ༈ /dbyangs can ma dkar mo phyag bzhi ma'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang man ngag dang bcas pa zla ba gzhon nu'i 'khri shing zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ 'phags bzhi skyed dang rol pa'i yum// rdo rje lha mo dbyangs can mar// btud nas de yi sgrub thabs dang*// rjes gnang man ngag 'dus gsal bri// 'di la gsum/ sgrub pa'i thabs/ rjes su gnang ba/ las tshogs kyi nges pa'o// dang po ni/ pha rol gyi rgol ba tshar gcad pa dang*/ mtha' yas pa'i spobs pa bskyed pa dang*/ phrin las sna tshogs pa sgrub par 'dod pas/ nyams dga' ba'i sman ljongs dang*/ yid du 'ong ba'i brag ri zla ba ltar dkar ba'i phug tu/ khrus dang gtsang sbra la gnas pas/ sgo gsum rnam par g.yeng ba'i tshogs spangs shing rtse gcig pa'i yid kyis 'jug par bya ste/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// zhes skyabs 'gro ci nus dang*/

shes rab snying brtse dang bcas pa'i// brtson pas sems can don du bdag /sangs rgyas mdun du gnas bcas te// rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed bgyi// zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ rang skad cig gis rdo rje dbyangs can mar gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i hrīṃ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas/ lho phyogs yid kyi rol mtsho na bzhugs pa'i 'phags ma thugs ka'i 'khor lo rin po che'i gzhal med khang dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs par gyur/ oṃ e h+ye hi badz+ra de wī ma hā tsakra sa ma yāṣ+ṭaṃ sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ/ añtsa ma naṃ/ puṣ+pe nas shab+da'i bar dang*/ a laṃ kā ra/ mā la/ wī ṇi/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gīrti nīrti zhes sbyar ba dang*/ rdo rje dbyangs can lha mo la// gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul// sdig pa'i tshogs kun so sor bshags// dge ba kun la rjes yi rang*// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs// bsod nams 'gro ba yongs la bsngo// bla med byang chub myur thob shog /ces yan lag brgyad dang bcas pas mchod/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas mdun gyi gzhal med khang gnas/ lha mo'i sku rang lus/ thugs ka'i 'khor lo snying gar thim pa las/ gnas khang shel dang*/ baiḍūr+ya dang*/ pad+ma rā ga dang*/ gser bzang las grub pa'i gzhal med khang grub zhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/ rgyan sna tshogs kyis kun nas spras pa'i dbus su/ rang nyid skad cig gis lha mo dbyangs can mar gyur pa ni/ sku mdog dang zhal gsum dkar ba/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis ral gri dang*/ ut+pa la/ 'og ma gnyis kyis pi waṃ sbreng ba/ pad zla la rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing lo bcu drug lon pa ltar lang tsho la bab pa/

dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ snying pad+ma 'dab brgyad kha zum pa'i dbus su hrīṃ yig dkar po rin po che'i sgron me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od kyis snying gi pad+ma kha bye ba'i 'dab ma brgyad la dbyangs yig gnyis gnyis gnas pa dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ rang dang sems can thams cad kyi ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i mkhyen pa'i ye shes bdud rtsi'i rnam par spyan drangs te thim pas pad+ma yi ge dang bcas pa gsal zhing 'bar ba'i snang bas shes bya thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i blo gros kyi mthu mchog tu rgyas par bsams la/ hrīṃ zhes pa'i yi ge 'bru gcig pa 'bum phrag bco lnga bzlas pas 'og nas 'byung ba'i ltas rnams mthong ba ni bsnyen pa'i tshul lo// sgrub pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i bzlas pa ni/ thugs kar pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar hrīṃ/ 'dab ma brgyad la dbyangs bcu drug g.yas skor/ yig 'bru rnams ral gri phyed pa'i gdan la gnas pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ rang gi sgrib gnyis kyi mun pa bsal zhing blo gros kyi mthu brtan par byas/ sems can thams cad kyi sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs te/ tshur 'dus pa dang lhan cig tu brtan g.yo'i dwangs bcud thams cad snying ga'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim par mos pas/ oṃ badz+ra de wī pi tsu pi tsu pradzñā war+d+dha hrīṃ hūm̐/ 'bum phrag gsum bzla bar gsungs na'ang bzhi 'gyur gyi rig pas bcu gnyis bzlas na rtags rnams rdzogs par 'gyur ro// rtags ni/ nangs par skya rengs shar ba'i dus su zla ba rgyas pa dang*/ skar ma pa wa sangs dang*/ sgron ma 'bar ba rnams dngos sam rmi lam du mthong na rim pa bzhin du gzi brjid rgyas pa dang*/ dbyangs snyan pa dang*/ yid gsal bar 'gyur zhing*/ thun mong du lkugs pa yin kyang ngag gi dbang phyug chen po'i gnas thob par gsungs la/ mtshon cha'i 'khor lo mthong na nus pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro// rtags rdzogs pas las thams cad thogs pa med par 'grub bo// thun las ldang ba na/

rang lha mor gsal ba thugs ka'i 'khor lo la thim/ de hrīṃ la thim par gyur pa'i mos pas sems bzung zhing mthar dmigs med du bzhag dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam gdab/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug go /gnyis pa ni/ stegs bu'i dbus su mañdzi'i khar maṇ+ḍa lar me tog gi tshom bu dang*/ mdun du dkar gsum mngar gsum gyi gtor ma/ chu gsum sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod rnams bsham/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ me tog sogs mchod pa byin rlabs spyi ltar dang*/ pā d+yaṃ gyi rjes su/ añtsa ma naṃ sbyar ba sngon du 'gro bas bdag bskyed gong ltar bya/ mdun bskyed ni/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas lho phyogs yid kyi rol mtsho nas 'phags ma rten dang brten par bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs par gyur/ oṃ e h+ye hi sogs nas/ nīrti zhes mchod pa'i bar gong ltar dang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mdun gyi rten dang dbyer med du thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las shel dang sogs nas/ spras pa'i dbus su/ lha mo dbyangs can ma sku mdog dang zhal gsum dkar ba sogs nas/ rin po ches brgyan pa/ thugs kar pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa rab tu rgyas pa'i dbus su hrīṃ/ 'dab ma brgyad la dbyangs yig gnyis gnyis gnas par gyur/ mchod pa bsang sbyangs byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ badz+ra de wī swa ra swa stī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gīrti nīrti bar sbyar bas mchod/ 'jam dbyangs lha mo dbyangs snyan ma// rab mdzes tshangs dbyangs blo bzang ma// mtshungs med snying dbus mgrin skyong ma// 'dod rgur bsgyur la phyag 'tshal lo// bde ldan ngag gi dbang phyug ma// mi 'tshe mi bslu tshe 'dzin ma// bag yod yid 'ong bde ster ma// tshangs spyod tshangs rigs ma khyod 'dud// ces bstod/

bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la blo gros kyi mthu phun sum tshogs pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa cung zad bya/ mthar gtor ma bsang sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang a kā ros brlab/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra prī ti de wī sa pa ri wā ra a mṛ ta ba liṃ khā hi khā hi/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum gyis dbul/ gong ltar mchod cing bstod la 'dod don gsol/ de nas rjes gnang dngos ni/ chos bshad ji ltar rigs pas mtshams sbyar te/ de la 'dir gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni/ 'phags ma dbyangs can mas rjes su bzung ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po zla ba gzhon nu nas nye bar brgyud de/ bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta bud+dha shrī las khro phu lo tsā ba chen po gnubs byams pa'i dpal gyis gsan pa'i rdo rje lha mo dbyangs can ma dkar mo phyag bzhi ma'i rjes su gnang ba bsgrub pa la slob dpon gyi bya ba grub nas sogs 'brel bkod la/ maṇ+ḍal/ gsol 'debs nas bzung dge bsngo bar kho bos byas pa'i ni ri ti pa'i lugs kyi byams pa'i rjes gnang la lha sngags kyi khyad par sogs ma 'khrul bar sbyar bas grub cing*/ rjes su mdun bskyed la mchod bstod/ nongs bshags/ gshegs gsol/ bdag bskyed bsdu rim bsngo smon shis brjod bcas spyi ltar bya'o// gsum pa ni/ gong du bshad pa'i bsnyen sgrub sngon du song bas/ tshar bcad pa'i las lnga dang*/ rjes su bzung ba'i las lnga ste bcu phrag rnams bsgrub pa ste/ rgya gzhung sa bcad dang bcas pa las blo gros kyi mig phye ste shes par bya'o// 'jam pa'i dbyangs sogs 'phags rnams kyi// mkhyen brtse'i dbang po brnyes 'dod na// zla ba gzhon nu'i 'khri shing 'dis// rig pa'i chu gter rgyas par mdzod// ces pa'ang rgya bod kyi yig rnying gsal byed dang bcas pa las ngag 'don mdor bsdus pa'i tshul gyis 'jam dbyangs bla med dgyes pa'i 'bangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos sbyar ba'i dge bas 'gro kun so so yang dag pa'i rig pa bzhi'i ye shes la dbang 'byor pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
